title: VINCIBLE
description: This project adds a small amount of powers from Invincible, now tested
body:
# Vincible

Adds three playable superhero classes from the Invincible universe to your server — Viltrumite, High Class Viltrumite, and Red Rush. Each class has unique abilities and keybinds, balanced so that endgame vanilla players can still win in a fight.

## Classes

### Viltrumite
- Flight — double jump to take off, hold sprint mid-air for a speed boost
- Super strength — bonus attack damage and knockback
- Damage resistance — takes 45% of normal damage
- Fall Damage Immunity
- Passive health regeneration
- **Grab** — Sneak + Left Click to grab and drag nearby players

### High Class Viltrumite
- Everything a regular Viltrumite has, but stronger
- **Sonic Clap (F)** — shockwave that damages and launches all entities within 12 blocks, scaling by distance. 12s cooldown
- Faster regeneration — 1 full heart every 3 seconds
- **Grab** — Sneak + Left Click

### Red Rush
- Superhuman ground speed
- Passive Haste II — faster attack and mining speed
- **Slow Time (F)** — slows all nearby players for 10 seconds. 30s cooldown
- **Grab** — Sneak + Left Click to grab and drag nearby players
- No damage resistance — high risk, high mobility

## Commands
| Command | Description | Alias |
|---|---|---|
| `/viltrumite [give\|remove\|status\|list] [player]` | Manage Viltrumite powers | `/vilt` |
| `/highclass [give\|remove\|status] [player]` | Manage High Class powers | `/hc` |
| `/redrush [give\|remove\|status] [player]` | Manage Red Rush powers | `/rr` |

## Permissions
- `viltrumite.use` — toggle your own powers (default: op)
- `viltrumite.admin` — give/remove powers to others (default: op)

## Requirements
- Paper 1.21.1
- Java 21

All values (damage, speed, cooldowns, regen rate, and more) are configurable in `config.yml`.
